answers.sum: The book says the Sun is the star that keeps us warm. Explain in your own words how the Sun warms the Earth, and what would happen to us if the Sun stopped shining.
answers.said: The Sun gives out light and heat that warms the Earth.

answers.sum: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, but Venus is the hottest planet. Explain why Venus is hotter than Mercury.
answers.said: Venus is hotter than Mercury because its thick clouds trap heat around the planet.

answers.sum: Does Pluto have a moon? Tell me its name, and explain what a moon is.
answers.said: Pluto has a moon called Charon, and a moon is a rock that travels around a planet.

answers.sum: The book says Earth is the only planet with life, as far as we know. What does Earth have that the other planets do not? Name two things and explain why each one matters for life.
answers.said: Earth has air, water and warmth, so living things can grow here.

answers.sum: What keeps all the planets moving around the Sun? Explain what would happen if it stopped.
answers.said: Gravity keeps the planets moving around the Sun, and without it they would drift away.

answers.sum: The book asks if there are robots in space. What jobs do robots do in space, and why are robots better than people for those jobs?
answers.said: Robots in space take photos and collect rocks because space is too dangerous for people.

answers.sum: Astronauts sleep in space very differently from how you sleep at home. Describe how they sleep, and explain why they have to do it that way.
answers.said: Astronauts sleep in sleeping bags tied to the wall so they do not float around.

answers.sum: How does a rocket get into space? Describe what happens, and explain why it needs so much power.
answers.said: A rocket burns fuel to push itself up, and it needs lots of power to escape gravity.

answers.sum: Describe what is inside the Earth, layer by layer, from the outside to the middle. Which layer is the hottest, and why?
answers.said: The Earth has a crust, a mantle and a hot core in the middle.

answers.sum: What is a volcano? Explain in your own words what happens when a volcano erupts, and where the hot rock comes from.
answers.said: A volcano is a mountain where hot melted rock bursts out from inside the Earth.

answers.sum: How do mountains form? Explain the idea of the Earth's plates pushing together, in your own words.
answers.said: Mountains form when huge plates of rock push together and crumple upward.

answers.sum: What are fossils, and what can they tell us about animals and plants that lived long ago? Give one example of something we learned from fossils.
answers.said: Fossils are the remains of old animals and plants that show us how they lived long ago.

answers.sum: What is a glacier, and how is an iceberg different from a glacier? Explain both.
answers.said: A glacier is a slow river of ice on land, while an iceberg is a piece of ice floating in the sea.

answers.sum: The book shows how people damage the Earth. Choose two ways people damage the Earth, and explain what harm each one does.
answers.said: People damage the Earth by cutting down trees and by throwing rubbish into nature.

answers.sum: What is recycling? Explain how recycling helps the Earth, and name two things from your own home that can be recycled.
answers.said: Recycling means using old things again, and at home we can recycle paper and bottles.
